description: As reparse-strict-empty-before-reading, without q. No symbol after p can read, so the strict item of r never advances over the empty p, and the condition on $x is never evaluated. The check passes (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a0 | c
%rule a0 A [+T] B
%rule c A [+T r] B [+U]
%rule r $x(p)
%conditions ~z ⊆ tag(text($x))
%rule p ε | B
